title: Loop release candidate dossier
description: Issue #264's candidate manifest, expanded with the required-evidence categories the issue lists. One dossier describes exactly one candidate_sha; a rerun against a different SHA is a different dossier, never an edit of this one in place.

candidate_sha.description: The exact commit every check, build, and artifact below must derive from. A dossier with checks recorded against more than one SHA is invalid.

base_sha.description: The branch point candidate_sha is qualified relative to (normally the current stable tag).

checks.description: One entry per required-evidence category from issue #264. Each is 'pass', 'fail', or 'waived' (never silently omitted); a category with no automation yet is 'not-run', which blocks promotion the same as 'fail'.

evidence_url.description: Link to the hosted CI run, log, or generated report this status is derived from.

waiver_reason.description: Required when status is 'waived'; must name an owner and a milestone (issue #264 AC5).

built_from_sha.description: Must equal the dossier's candidate_sha; validate_release_candidate_dossier.py enforces the cross-field equality.

sbom.description: Path or URL to this artifact's SBOM.

attestation.description: Path or URL to this artifact's build provenance attestation.

stable_sha.description: The last known-good stable commit to roll back to.

procedure.description: Concrete steps, not a pointer to "the usual process" -- issue #264 requires this be actionable without re-deriving it under incident pressure.
